metadata.title: Mid-Century Soul Duotone Album Cover
useCases: Soul and R&B themed editorial layouts

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast magenta and black duotone portrait layout featuring bold cyan block typography in a staggered arrangement.
triggerTerms: cyan block lettering on pink background

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant magenta-washed portrait of a woman in a fur collar, framed by a thin white border. The composition is anchored by heavy, cyan-colored sans-serif typography that is split between the top-left and bottom-right corners, creating a diagonal tension across the central photographic subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal typographic balance between top-left and bottom-right
Tight cropping on the subject's face and hair
coreInvariants: Magenta duotone filter over the entire image area
Thin white outer border framing the square composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait centered slightly to the left, with the head filling the vertical height of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large cyan text blocks in the corners act as the primary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left title, down through the subject's face, to the artist name in the bottom-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with imagery and large-scale type.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation magenta with high-contrast black shadows; typography is a flat, bright cyan with no shading.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold, condensed sans-serif with geometric influence.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' has very short, horizontal terminals
The 'R' has a straight, diagonal leg starting from the stem
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Large cyan display type paired with smaller white informational text blocks.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display type.
Provides a similar mid-century industrial feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square, high-contrast magenta and black duotone portrait of a woman with a 1960s hairstyle and a fur collar, framed by a thin white border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, bold, condensed cyan sans-serif text in the top-left and bottom-right corners. Add a smaller block of white sans-serif text in the bottom-left corner.

verificationChecks: Is the image a magenta/black duotone?
Is there a thin white border around the edge?
Is the text arranged in a staggered diagonal layout?

adjustableVariables: Duotone color pair (e.g., yellow/black instead of magenta/black)
postGenerationChecks: Check that the magenta is vibrant and not muted.
Ensure the cyan text is legible against the magenta background.
Verify the white border is consistent on all four sides.
Confirm the typography is strictly sans-serif and bold.
recipe.reuseFormula: Duotone Portrait + Staggered Block Typography + High Contrast Palette
